title: Your First Weekend at Davidson College, Shared as Cards
description: A curated sequence of essential Davidson College experiences for a new student's first weekend, from historic traditions to local favorites.

cards.title: Kick Off at the Opening Session
cards.subtitle: Friday Evening Orientation Kickoff
cards.notes: Join your new Wildcat family at the Baker Sports Complex for the official opening session that marks the start of your Davidson journey.
cards.short_summary: The official opening session for new students and families at Baker Sports Complex.
cards.evidence_claim: New students and their families kick off Orientation with an Opening Session at the Baker Sports Complex.
cards.access_notes: Mandatory for new students; typically held on the first Friday evening of orientation.

cards.title: Relax by Lake Norman
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Waterfront Social
cards.notes: Take the shuttle to the 110-acre Lake Campus for swimming, volleyball, and kayaking. It is a signature spot for orientation socials.
cards.short_summary: A 110-acre waterfront property on Lake Norman for student recreation and orientation events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lake Campus hosts orientation socials and offers free equipment checkout for kayaks and paddleboards for students.
cards.access_notes: Open 7 a.m. – 7 p.m. daily; CatCard required for entry. Alcohol-free facility.

cards.title: The Welcome Back Party
cards.subtitle: Saturday Night Social Hub
cards.notes: Head to 'The Union' for the first major social event of the year. Expect themed decor, music, and a chance to meet the whole campus.
cards.short_summary: The first major student-led programming event of the year held at the Alvarez College Union.
cards.evidence_claim: The Welcome Back Party is the first Union Board event of the year, held at the Alvarez College Union.
cards.source_title: Spotlight on the Union Board - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; typically held on the first or second weekend of the fall semester.

cards.title: Coffee at 'Nummit'
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Study Spot
cards.notes: Known by students as 'Nummit,' this on-campus coffee shop is the heart of Patterson Court. Perfect for a low-key Sunday morning.
cards.short_summary: The student-run on-campus location of Summit Coffee, a central hub for student life.
cards.evidence_claim: Summit Outpost, coined 'nummit' by students, is the on-campus option for coffee and a hub for student events.
cards.access_notes: Students can use Dining Dollars here; check for late-night weekend hours.

cards.title: Gear Up on Main Street
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon Shopping
cards.notes: Walk to Main Street to grab your Wildcat gear and textbooks. It's the official campus bookstore located in the heart of town.
cards.short_summary: The official college bookstore and merchandise provider located on Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Davidson College Store is located at 137 N. Main St. and serves as the campus bookstore.
cards.access_notes: Located off-campus on Main Street; open daily with varying weekend hours.

cards.title: The Freshman Cake Race
cards.subtitle: Wednesday Tradition Preview
cards.notes: While the race is Wednesday, use the weekend to scout the route starting at the Wildcat Statue. It's a 95-year-old tradition.
cards.short_summary: A historic 1.3 to 1.7 mile race for first-year students where winners receive handmade cakes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Freshman Cake Race is held the Wednesday of the first week of classes, starting at the Wildcat statue.
cards.source_title: Davidson Cake Race a Sweet College Tradition Since 1930
cards.access_notes: Participation is for first-year students; the community gathers to watch and provide cakes.

cards.title: Explore the Galleries
cards.subtitle: Sunday Cultural Walk
cards.notes: Visit the Van Every/Smith Galleries to see rotating exhibitions. It's a quiet, inspiring space to visit before classes begin.
cards.short_summary: The Katherine and Tom Belk Visual Arts Center houses galleries and art studios.
cards.evidence_claim: The Van Every/Smith Galleries are free and open to the public, with weekend hours from 12-4 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Galleries are open weekends 12-4 p.m.; free admission.

cards.title: Find Your Study Nook
cards.subtitle: Sunday Evening Prep
cards.notes: Get ahead by finding your favorite spot in the library. During renovations, the Lilly Gallery serves as a main collaborative space.
cards.short_summary: The central academic library of Davidson College, currently undergoing major renovations.
cards.evidence_claim: The library is open to students 24/7 during the academic year; Lilly Gallery is a main collaborative study space during renovation.
cards.access_notes: 24/7 access for students with CatCard during the academic year.

cards.title: Stroll Through Downtown
cards.subtitle: The Town-Gown Connection
cards.notes: Explore the 'Hallmark movie' charm of Main Street. It's highly walkable and filled with local cafes and independent boutiques.
cards.short_summary: The historic and walkable downtown corridor adjacent to the Davidson College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Davidson's historic Main Street is known for its walkability, red brick streets, and locally owned shops.
cards.source_title: Day in the Life: What Does a Weekend Look Like at Davidson College?
cards.access_notes: Public street; most shops are open during standard daytime and weekend hours.

cards.title: First Meal at 'Commons'
cards.subtitle: The Primary Dining Hall
cards.notes: Experience your first meal at the main dining hall. It's where the community gathers for fresh, sustainable food options.
cards.short_summary: The primary dining facility for Davidson College students, focusing on variety and nutrition.
cards.evidence_claim: First-year students are required to have a meal plan, with Vail Commons serving as a primary dining location.
cards.access_notes: Requires meal plan or CatCard for entry; check daily hours for weekend service.
